Resources.name: Role
Resources.description: Roles supported by the endpoint. These are used as a lookup catalog for managing the user roles attribute.

Resources.name: Entitlement
Resources.description: Entitlements supported by the endpoint. These are used as a lookup catalog for managing the user entitlements attribute.

attributes.name: userName
attributes.description: The user’s unique identifier (login). Required and unique across all users. On create: if the request supplies a `userName`, use it as-is. Otherwise generate one from the full name (given name(s) and family name ): split into space-delimited tokens, join them with `.`, lowercase, and transliterate to plain ASCII (remove accents and expand ligatures: æ -> ae, ø -> o, å -> a, ä -> a, ö -> o, ü -> u, é -> e, è -> e, ñ -> n, ß -> ss). Then remove all characters except `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `-` and `_`, collapse repeated periods and trim leading/trailing periods. Example: `Åse Kari Kjærøy` -> `ase.kari.kjaeroy`. HTTP 409 Conflict rule: if creation fails with `HTTP 409 Conflict` because `userName` is already taken (SCIM `scimType: uniqueness`), append a number, starting at 2, then retry. Example: `ase.kari.kjaeroy` -> `ase.kari.kjaeroy2`. Try numbers 2-5, then report failure. On update: do not change `userName` unless explicitly requested.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The user’s real name and its components, including given, family, and middle names, a formatted name, titles, and suffixes.

subAttributes.name: formatted
subAttributes.description: The full name, including middle names, titles and suffixes, formatted for display.

subAttributes.name: familyName
subAttributes.description: The family (last) name: the final token of the full name, unless family name is stated explicitly.

subAttributes.name: givenName
subAttributes.description: The given (first, including middle) name(s): all tokens of the full name except the last, unless the given name is stated explicitly.

subAttributes.name: middleName
subAttributes.description: The middle name(s).

subAttributes.name: honorificPrefix
subAttributes.description: The honorific prefix (title), such as `Mr.` or `Dr.`

subAttributes.name: honorificSuffix
subAttributes.description: The honorific suffix, such as `Jr.`

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: The user’s full name (`givenName` + `familyName`). On create: if not supplied, use `givenName` + space + `familyName`.

attributes.name: nickName
attributes.description: The user’s casual name, if different from the given name.

attributes.name: profileUrl
attributes.description: The URL of the user’s online profile page.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The user’s job title.

attributes.name: userType
attributes.description: The user’s organization relationship, such as `Employee` or `Contractor`.

attributes.name: preferredLanguage
attributes.description: The user’s preferred written or spoken language (language tag).

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: The user’s default location for localizing currency, dates and numbers (language tag).

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: The user’s time zone in IANA (Olson) format.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: The user’s administrative status: `true` means enabled and `false` means disabled. On create: `true` unless otherwise stated. On modify: `false` to disable, `true` to enable.

attributes.name: password
attributes.description: The user’s clear-text password, used to set an initial password or reset it. Never returned. Set only when a password is provided.

attributes.name: emails
attributes.description: The user’s email addresses, with types `work`, `home`, or `other`.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The user’s email address, canonicalized to lowercase.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label for the address’s function: `work`, `home`, or `other`.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: `true` for the preferred email address. At most one address may be primary.

attributes.name: phoneNumbers
attributes.description: The user’s phone numbers, with types `mobile`, `work`, `home`, `fax`, `pager`, or `other`.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The user’s phone number, as provided.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label for the number’s function: `mobile`, `work`, `home`, `fax`, `pager`, or `other`.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: `true` for the preferred phone number. At most one number may be primary.

attributes.name: ims
attributes.description: The user’s instant messaging addresses.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The user’s instant messaging address, as provided.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The messaging service: `aim`, `gtalk`, `icq`, `xmpp`, `msn`, `skype`, `qq`, or `yahoo`.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: `true` for the preferred messaging address. At most one address may be primary.

attributes.name: photos
attributes.description: URLs of the user’s photos.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: A URL of the user’s photo, as provided.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The photo’s function: `photo` or `thumbnail`.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: `true` for the preferred photo. At most one photo may be primary.

attributes.name: addresses
attributes.description: The user’s physical mailing addresses, including known parts such as `formatted`, `streetAddress`, `locality`, `region`, `postalCode`, and `country`.

subAttributes.name: formatted
subAttributes.description: The full mailing address, formatted for display or use with a mailing label. This attribute MAY contain newlines.

subAttributes.name: streetAddress
subAttributes.description: The full street address, which may include house number, street name, PO BOX, and multi-line extended street address information. This attribute MAY contain newlines.

subAttributes.name: locality
subAttributes.description: The city or locality.

subAttributes.name: region
subAttributes.description: The state or region.

subAttributes.name: postalCode
subAttributes.description: The zipcode or postal code.

subAttributes.name: country
subAttributes.description: The country name.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label indicating the attribute’s function; e.g., `work`, `home` or `other`.

attributes.name: groups
attributes.description: Groups the user belongs to, whether directly or indirectly (through nested or dynamic membership). New entries are always direct; send only `value`. Only entries with type `direct` can be removed. The `groups.value` is the group’s `id`.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The `id` of the group resource, not its name.

subAttributes.name: $ref
subAttributes.description: The URI of the corresponding `Group` resource to which the user belongs.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display. `readOnly`.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: `direct` or `indirect` membership. Set by the server.

attributes.name: entitlements
attributes.description: The user’s assigned entitlements.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The entitlement’s id, as listed by the service provider’s entitlement catalog.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: The entitlement’s display name. Recommended when adding.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The entitlement’s type, as listed by the service provider’s entitlement catalog.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: `true` for the preferred entitlement. At most one entitlement may be primary. Optional.

attributes.name: roles
attributes.description: Roles assigned to the user.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The role’s id, as listed by the service provider’s role catalog.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: The role’s display name. Recommended when adding.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The role’s type, as listed by the service provider’s role catalog.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: `true` for the preferred role. At most one role may be primary. Optional.

attributes.name: x509Certificates
attributes.description: Certificates issued to the user.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The X.509 certificate, base64 encoded (DER), as provided.

subAttributes.name: display
subAttributes.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes. Optional.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: A label for the certificate’s function. Optional.

subAttributes.name: primary
subAttributes.description: `true` for the preferred certificate. At most one certificate may be primary.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: The name of the group. Required and unique across all groups.

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: Members of the group.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The `id` of the member resource (`User` or `Group`), not a `userName` or `displayName`.

subAttributes.name: $ref
subAttributes.description: The URI of the member resource. Set by the service provider.

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The member resource type: `User` or `Group`. The server derives it from value

Resources.name: EnterpriseUser
Resources.description: The user’s enterprise attributes, including `employeeNumber`, `costCenter`, `organization`, `division`, `department`, and `manager`.

attributes.name: employeeNumber
attributes.description: The user’s identifier assigned by the organization.

attributes.name: costCenter
attributes.description: The user’s cost center name.

attributes.name: organization
attributes.description: The user’s organization name.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: The user’s division name.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The user’s department name.

attributes.name: manager
attributes.description: The user’s manager, referencing the `id` of the manager’s `User` resource.

subAttributes.name: value
subAttributes.description: The manager’s `id` attribute. Never a `userName` or `displayName`. Set to "" to clear the manager.

subAttributes.name: $ref
subAttributes.description: The URI of the manager’s `User` resource. Set by the service provider.

subAttributes.name: displayName
subAttributes.description: The manager’s name. `readOnly`.

Resources.description: Roles supported by the endpoint. These are used as a lookup catalog for managing the user’s roles attribute.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The role’s unique identifier.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: The role’s name.

attributes.name: type

Resources.name: Entitlement
Resources.description: Entitlements supported by the endpoint. These are used as a lookup catalog for managing the user’s entitlements attribute.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The entitlement’s unique identifier.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: The entitlement’s name.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: A tag used to categorize the entitlement

attributes.name: typeInfo
attributes.description: Specifies additional information about the entitlement’s type. The `subAttributes` may vary depending on the entitlement type.

Resources.name: Service Provider Configuration
Resources.description: Schema for representing the service provider’s configuration

attributes.name: documentationUri
attributes.description: An HTTP addressable URL pointing to the service provider’s human consumable help documentation.

attributes.name: patch
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies `PATCH` configuration options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

attributes.name: bulk
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies `BULK` configuration options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

subAttributes.name: maxOperations
subAttributes.description: An integer value specifying the maximum number of operations.

subAttributes.name: maxPayloadSize
subAttributes.description: An integer value specifying the maximum payload size in bytes.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies `FILTER` options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

subAttributes.name: maxResults
subAttributes.description: Integer value specifying the maximum number of resources returned in a response.

attributes.name: changePassword
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies change password options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

attributes.name: sort
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies sort result options.

subAttributes.name: supported
subAttributes.description: Boolean value specifying whether the operation is supported.

attributes.name: authenticationSchemes
attributes.description: A complex type that specifies supported Authentication Scheme properties.

subAttributes.name: name
subAttributes.description: The common authentication scheme name; e.g., `HTTP Basic`.

subAttributes.name: description
subAttributes.description: A description of the authentication scheme.

subAttributes.name: specUri
subAttributes.description: An HTTP-addressable URL pointing to the authentication scheme’s specification.

subAttributes.name: documentationUri
subAttributes.description: An HTTP-addressable URL pointing to the authentication scheme’s usage documentation.

Resources.name: ResourceType
Resources.description: Specifies the schema that describes a SCIM Resource Type

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The resource type’s server-unique `id`. It may be the same as its `name`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The resource type name. When applicable, service providers MUST use the name specified in the core schema specification; e.g., `User`.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The resource type’s human-readable description. When applicable, service providers MUST use the description specified in the core schema specification.

attributes.name: endpoint
attributes.description: The resource type’s HTTP-addressable endpoint relative to the base URL; e.g., `/Users`.

attributes.name: schema
attributes.description: The resource types primary/base schema URI

attributes.name: schemaExtensions
attributes.description: A list of URIs of the resource type’s schema extensions

subAttributes.name: schema
subAttributes.description: The URI of a schema extension.

subAttributes.name: required
subAttributes.description: A Boolean value that specifies whether the schema extension is required for the resource type. If `true`, a resource of this type MUST include this schema extension and any attributes declared as required in it. If `false`, a resource of this type MAY omit this schema extension.

Resources.name: Schema
Resources.description: Specifies the schema that describes a SCIM Schema

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The unique URI of the schema. When applicable, service providers MUST use the URI specified in the core schema specification.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The schema’s human-readable name. When applicable, service providers MUST use the name specified in the core schema specification; e.g., `User`.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The schema’s human-readable description. When applicable, service providers MUST use the description specified in the core schema specification.

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: A complex attribute that includes the attributes of a schema

subAttributes.name: name
subAttributes.description: The attribute’s name

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The attribute’s data type. Valid values include `string`, `complex`, `boolean`, `decimal`, `integer`, `dateTime`, and `reference`.

subAttributes.name: multiValued
subAttributes.description: Boolean indicating an attribute’s plurality.

subAttributes.name: description
subAttributes.description: A human readable description of the attribute.

subAttributes.name: required
subAttributes.description: A boolean indicating if the attribute is required.

subAttributes.name: canonicalValues
subAttributes.description: A collection of canonical values. When applicable, service providers MUST specify the canonical values defined in the core schema specification; e.g., `work` and `home`.

subAttributes.name: caseExact
subAttributes.description: Indicates if a string attribute is case-sensitive.

subAttributes.name: mutability
subAttributes.description: Indicates if an attribute is modifiable.

subAttributes.name: returned
subAttributes.description: Indicates when an attribute is returned in a response. Values include `always`, `never`, `default`, and `request`.

subAttributes.name: uniqueness
subAttributes.description: Indicates how unique a value must be.

subAttributes.name: referenceTypes
subAttributes.description: Used only with an attribute of type `reference`. Specifies a SCIM resource type that a reference attribute MAY refer to; e.g., `User`.

subAttributes.name: subAttributes
subAttributes.description: Used to define the sub-attributes of a complex attribute

subAttributes.name: name
subAttributes.description: The attribute’s name

subAttributes.name: type
subAttributes.description: The attribute’s data type. Valid values include: `string`, `complex`, `boolean`, `decimal`, `integer`, `dateTime`, `reference`.

subAttributes.name: multiValued
subAttributes.description: Boolean indicating an attribute’s plurality.

subAttributes.name: description
subAttributes.description: A human readable description of the attribute.

subAttributes.name: required
subAttributes.description: A boolean indicating if the attribute is required.

subAttributes.name: canonicalValues
subAttributes.description: A collection of canonical values. When applicable, service providers MUST specify the canonical values defined in the core schema specification; e.g., `work` and `home`.

subAttributes.name: caseExact
subAttributes.description: Indicates if a string attribute is case-sensitive.

subAttributes.name: mutability
subAttributes.description: Indicates if an attribute is modifiable.

subAttributes.name: returned
subAttributes.description: Indicates when an attribute is returned in a response. Values include `always`, `never`, `default`, and `request`.

subAttributes.name: uniqueness
subAttributes.description: Indicates how unique a value must be.

subAttributes.name: referenceTypes
subAttributes.description: Used only with an attribute of type `reference`. Specifies a SCIM `resourceType` that a reference attribute MAY refer to; e.g., `User`.
